transcript:
SOURCE: Fathom (via HubSpot internal notes) — https://fathom.video/share/Pw8AXt6WyhaLXmTzDTP3bcCX5DzgN8px

AI Meeting Summary ✨

Generated by Fathom // View Recording (50 mins - No highlights)

Meeting Purpose

Explore growth strategies for Rivas Law Firm.

Key Takeaways

Goal: Double revenue from $1.5–2M gross to $3–4M gross, driven by a desire for more personal time and delegation.

Problem: Growth is stagnant, relying on an unpredictable word-of-mouth model that yields only 5–6 new cases/month.

Blocker: The proposed $100k annual marketing budget is effectively only $40k for digital, as $60k is committed to low-ROI billboards.

Solution: SMB Team will present a custom plan combining immediate-impact paid ads with long-term SEO and intake support to build a scalable, predictable growth engine.

Topics

Current State & Growth Goals

Firm: Rivas Law Firm, a solo PI practice in the Rio Grande Valley (RGV) with contract attorneys.

Performance:

Revenue: $1.5–2M gross / ~$500k net.

Caseload: 5–6 new cases/month, maintaining a 60–80 case docket.

Source: 95% word-of-mouth referrals.

Goal: Double revenue to $3–4M gross to enable hiring, delegation, and more personal time.

Marketing Budget & Strategy Mismatch

Proposed Budget: $100k annual marketing spend.

Effective Digital Budget: Only $40k/year (~$3.3k/month).

Reason: $60k/year ($5k/month) is committed to two billboards.

Billboard ROI: Extremely low, yielding only ~5 cases in the last year.

SMB Team's Position: A $3.3k/month budget is insufficient for a competitive PI market. The strategy should prioritize high-ROI lead generation (digital) over low-ROI branding (billboards).

Digital Presence & Competitor Analysis

Rivas Law Firm's Presence:

Website: Built by a son; not actively managed.

Traffic: ~16 organic visitors/month.

Language: English-only, a critical mismatch for the 95% Spanish-speaking client base.

Competitor Analysis (Leah Wise):

Strategy: Aggressive SEO and reputation management (1,000+ reviews).

Result: ~2,000 organic visitors/month, enabling a reduction in paid ad spend.

Competitor Analysis (Ruy Mireles):

Strategy: Uses paid ads to target a market (Pharr) without a physical office.

Result: Shows the immediate impact of paid ads, but also highlights the long-term advantage of a local, SEO-optimized presence.

SMB Team's Proposed Solution

Methodology: The "Law Firm Growth Acceleration Model" focuses on four pillars:

Lead Gen: Proactive marketing (SEO, paid ads) to own demand.

Intake: Systems to convert leads efficiently.

Team: Structures for delegation and scalability.

Profit Planning: Financial roadmaps to ensure profitable growth.

Recommended Strategy: A custom, "done-for-you" plan combining:

Paid Ads: For immediate case generation.

SEO: To build a long-term, compounding asset.

Website Redesign: To be bilingual (English/Spanish) and SEO-optimized.

Intake Support: To handle increased lead volume.

Next Steps

Nick Holderman (SMB Team):

Develop a custom growth strategy and investment proposal.

Send a calendar invite for the follow-up meeting.

Atty. Israel Rivas:

Review the proposal and decide on the marketing budget.

Follow-up Meeting:

Date: Monday, August 17, 2026

Time: 1:30 PM

Action Items

Check for SMB Team PI clients in Far/McAllen; share w/ Israel - WATCH (5 secs)
Draft custom PI marketing plan for Israel (Far/McAllen): bilingual site, SEO+AEO, Google Ads, intake, reviews; include ROI/budget - WATCH (5 secs)
Send Zoom invite to Israel for Aug 17 1:30 presentation; then present plan/ROI/budget - WATCH (5 secs)
